Class 11–12 Maths · Exponential & Logarithmic Functions
Maths, visualised #3

Once a year: ₹2. Twice: ₹2.25. Every month: ₹2.61. Every day: ₹2.71. Every second: ₹2.71828… → B.
Adding it more often always helps, but less and less: the total never passes 2.71828… That number is e, and it's why eˣ is everywhere in Class 12 calculus.
